cues.en: The Smorpians disagree.

cues.en: And they noticed humanity,

cues.en: If you want to learn more about the mind numbing problem

cues.en: so no human survivors will come to an act of vengeance on swap in the future.

cues.en: In interstellar war, you want to win with one shot.

cues.en: As an advanced technological civilization,

cues.en: What if all the power of the Dyson swarm,

cues.zh: 让它在天空中清晰可见。
cues.en: makes it clearly visible in the sky.

cues.en: A gigantic column of green light.

cues.en: The laser travels at the speed of light,

cues.en: which, oddly enough, is still pretty slow on a galactic level.

cues.zh: 整整一天后，激光才离开 Smorpian 星系，

cues.zh: 射入恒星之间的虚空。
cues.en: shooting into the emptiness between stars.

cues.zh: 它会飞行数十年，
cues.en: It will travel for decades,

cues.zh: 偶尔融化一点星际尘埃或小行星。
cues.en: occasionally melting the odd bit of interstellar dust or asteroid.

cues.zh: 发射后42年，它悄无声息地抵达。
cues.en: 42 years after being fired, it arrives without warning.

cues.en: Humans only notice a weird green glow in the sky,

cues.zh: 然后他们就没了。
cues.en: and then they're gone.

cues.zh: 一颗恒星1%的能量，
cues.en: 1% of the energy of a star,

cues.zh: 穿越42光年。
cues.en: traveling 42 light years.

cues.en: It burns the exposed half of the planet

cues.en: The seas boil and evaporate, fires scour the land,

cues.zh: 几分钟内地壳开始熔化成一片岩浆之海。
cues.en: and within minutes Earth's crust begins to melt into a sea of lava.

cues.zh: 随着星球自转，
cues.en: As the planet rotates,

cues.zh: 它变成一颗赤热的炼狱，毫无生命痕迹。
cues.en: it turns into a red hot hell with no trace of life.

cues.zh: 一天之后，一切结束，激光渐渐熄灭。
cues.en: After a day, it's all over and the laser dies down.

cues.zh: 再过42年，
cues.en: In another 42 years,

cues.zh: 斯莫普星人就会知道他们是否成功了。
cues.en: the Smorpians will know if they've been successful.

cues.en: That's another thing about interstellar war.

cues.zh: 你发动攻击时，要等你的孙辈才能知道你到底赢没赢。
cues.en: When you attack, your grandchildren will be the ones to find out if you won.

cues.zh: 就像二战时的所有炸弹在80年代才爆炸，
cues.en: It's like all the bombs from World War II exploding in the 80s

cues.en: and us only seeing the effect today.

cues.zh: 好，恒星激光的极远射程、光速攻击，
cues.en: OK, the star laser's extreme range, speed of light attack,

cues.en: and ability to melt down any target

cues.zh: 使它成为首屈一指的星际武器。
cues.en: make it a premier interstellar weapon.

cues.en: But is there something else?

cues.en: This sort of weapon is at the limits

cues.zh: 凭借无限的能量，

cues.zh: 来建造反物质火箭。
cues.en: to build antimatter rockets.

cues.en: but basically, if you have a really strong magnetic field

cues.zh: 就能让等离子体通过喷嘴偏转
cues.en: you can deflect the plasma through a nozzle

cues.en: just like in the chemical rockets humans use.

cues.zh: 但速度会快得多得多。
cues.en: But it would be much, much faster.

cues.zh: 基本上可以说是最快的火箭。
cues.en: The fastest rocket possibly basically.

cues.en: Our relativistic missile is much bigger than a skyscraper.

cues.zh: 底部是一个100米宽的钟形磁喷嘴。

cues.zh: 上面是250层，装满反物质与物质
cues.en: On top of it are 250 floors filled with antimatter and matter

cues.en: To stop them getting damaged on the way,

cues.en: the Smorpians build 1000 missiles.

to 99.9999996% of the speed of light.

…9999998% of the speed of light.

cues.en: Like a long trumpet of doom surrounded by an aura of deadly radiation.

cues.zh: 发射时，它会射出一道笔直如尺、指向地球的闪电束。
cues.en: When it's fired, it produces a ruler straight lightning bolt pointed at Earth.

cues.zh: 它到达后的效果比其他武器更不易察觉。
cues.en: Its effects on arrival are less visible than the other weapons.

cues.zh: 没有闪光，没有大规模火风暴，
cues.en: No flashes of light, no massive firestorms,

cues.zh: 没有爆炸。
cues.en: no explosions.

cues.zh: 它不摧毁岩石，它摧毁DNA。
cues.en: It doesn't destroy rocks, it destroys DNA.

cues.zh: 人们会头晕，随后因细胞被辐射穿透而生病。
cues.en: People get dizzy, then fall sick as their cells are pierced by radiation.

cues.zh: 你可能以为深层掩体能拯救少数人类，但并非如此。
cues.en: You might think that a deep bunker could save a few humans, but no.

cues.zh: UREB的穿透力极强，
cues.en: The UREB is so penetrating

cues.zh: 以至于即使在在地下，其效应也会累积到致命剂量，
cues.en: that its effects accumulate to lethal doses even underground,

cues.zh: 经过数天或数周。
cues.en: over days or weeks.

cues.zh: 最终，就像我们的草莓一样，
cues.en: In the end, just like our strawberries,

cues.zh: 地球变得寸草不生。
cues.en: Earth becomes sterile.

cues.zh: 嗯，又是Kurzgesagt制作的一部精心制作的动画科学解说，
cues.en: Hm, another elaborate animated science explainer by Kurzgesagt

cues.zh: 我们学到了很多，但不确定具体学到了什么。
cues.en: where we've learned a lot, not sure exactly what.

cues.zh: 幸运的是，斯莫普星人并不真的存在，
cues.en: Luckily, the Smorpians don't really exist,

cues.zh: 但其他外星人……可能存在。
cues.en: but others… might.

cues.zh: 我们所有武器的一大缺点是
cues.en: One major downside of all our weapons

cues.zh: 银河系周围的其他文明能看到你在发射它们，
cues.en: is that others around the Milky Way could see you firing them,

cues.zh: 这可不理想
cues.en: which is not ideal

cues.zh: 因为你不想把自己展现成一个危险的物种
cues.en: because you don't want to present yourself as a dangerous species

cues.zh: 还告诉所有人你的确切位置。
cues.en: and tell everybody where exactly you are.

cues.zh: 所以，与其向宇宙大声喊叫或开火，
cues.en: So maybe instead of shouting or shooting out into the universe,

cues.zh: 目前最好的做法似乎是保持相对安静，
cues.en: the best course of action seems to be to stay relatively quiet for now,

cues.zh: 然后观察。
cues.en: and observe.

cues.zh: 也许有一天我们会目睹遥远的恒星互相开火
cues.en: Maybe one day we'll witness distant stars shooting at each other

cues.zh: 并庆幸自己没有卷入其中。
cues.en: and be glad we stayed out of it.
